intro: A simple vessel used to carry fresh spring water from the local well in the Red Cloud Mesa. Greatmother Hawkwind directs young tauren to haul it back to Camp Narache to instill the values of humility, service, and respect for tribal elders.

p: Though modest in design, the water pitcher serves as an essential teaching tool for the youth of Camp Narache. Resting beside the water well on the plains southeast of the camp, it represents the daily labor required to sustain the community. By asking a novice to fill and carry the heavy vessel to Chief Hawkwind, Greatmother Hawkwind tests their character. The chore demonstrates that no duty is beneath a tribal protector, reminding young braves that tending to the everyday needs of their kin is just as vital as wielding a weapon on the hunt.
